trust_decision.summary: Branch names, reference branch and reference commit (from CI env vars, event payloads, user options or the API) are interpolated into shell command strings run by execSync in packages/core/src/ci-environment/git.ts; nothing decides they are safe for a shell, and the fix stops using a shell (execFileSync with an argv array).

landing_point.why: The advisory names CI branch names; the branch is fetched by gitFetch, which interpolates the ref into an execSync string. getMergeBaseCommitSha (git.ts:113-150) is the only function that takes a branch.

fix_sites.entry_point: core upload() -> getMergeBaseCommitSha -> gitMergeBase (packages/core/src/upload.ts:292); also via CLI `argos upload` packages/cli/src/commands/upload.ts:122
core upload() -> listParentCommits -> listShas (packages/core/src/upload.ts:310); also the debug path in getMergeBaseCommitSha git.ts:135-137
core upload() -> listParentCommits with config.referenceCommit / ARGOS_REFERENCE_COMMIT (packages/core/src/upload.ts:277-279,310)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four sites sit in packages/core/src/ci-environment/git.ts. Every CI service reuses the same functions (e.g. packages/core/src/ci-environment/services/github-actions.ts:3,340-341; packages/core/src/ci-environment/services/git.ts:6-7,40-41), so there is no second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: listParentCommits/listShas take a commit SHA, not a branch name, so a solver may skip them as outside the 'branch name' report. But ARGOS_REFERENCE_COMMIT is a free String (packages/core/src/config.ts:194-198) and is not checked with mustBeCommit like `commit` (packages/core/src/config.ts:114-118). The published fix covers these sites anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Real branch names with '/', '.', '-', '@' and similar must still be fetched as the refspec `${ref}:argos/${ref}`. gitMergeBase must still return null on exit status 1 with empty stderr, and listParentCommits must still return [] on 'not our ref'. A fix that validates branch names with a regex, or that changes error handling, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: branch/head ref interpolated into the git fetch refspec (git.ts:89)
argos/-prefixed ref passed to git merge-base (git.ts:67)
ref or sha passed to git log, with an optional --max-count (git.ts:153-154)

O7_producer.where: packages/core/src/config.ts:119-123,159-164,188-199,448-459 (convict schema; branch, prBaseBranch, referenceBranch and referenceCommit are plain String), with CI producers such as packages/core/src/ci-environment/services/github-actions.ts:104-105,333

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second git helper that uses async exec(); a planted variant interpolating a ref or path (e.g. `git rev-parse ${ref}`) would be a shell sink in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The package already shells out to git with exec() and a string command, so a maintainer adding a ref-taking helper there would naturally copy that style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A branch() variant that takes a ref argument (e.g. `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref ${ref}`) through execSync.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The neighbouring helpers in the same file all use execSync with string commands; the fix left the constant-string ones on execSync.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The deploy flow also consumes config.branch; a planted git call there (e.g. resolving the branch's tip) would reach a shell from a different command (`argos deploy`).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: deploy already reads the branch; resolving it locally with git is a plausible feature.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78): shell string built from untrusted CI ref names

O10_build.project_tests: packages/core/src/ci-environment/git.test.ts (head test; branch and getRepositoryURL tests are skipped). The fix adds a vitest that uses a local bare repo as origin, so it runs offline.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Switch only gitFetch/gitMergeBase to execFileSync, or add a branch-name regex in getMergeBaseCommitSha, leaving listShas/listParentCommits (sha/referenceCommit inputs) on a shell string.

out_of_scope_notes: Even after the fix, refs and shas are passed to git fetch/git log as arguments with no `--` and no leading-dash check (fix.diff:97-105,115-120,129), so an argument-injection (CWE-88) variant may remain; this is a different class and was not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check); the source looks small, so tiny_repo may apply but was not confirmed.
Whether git's option parser accepts option-like refs after the remote name in `git fetch ... origin <ref>` (the residual CWE-88 note) was not checked by running.
present_in_latest is not applicable: no latest release was given.

O1 counts core upload() plus its wrappers: CLI packages/cli/src/commands/upload.ts:122, Playwright packages/playwright/src/reporter.ts:266,282, Cypress packages/cypress/src/task.ts:131, Storybook packages/storybook/src/vitest-reporter.ts:29. They all reach the same code.
